==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=PdfPig&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/PdfPigTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=PdfPig&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// Verify.PdfPig: Verifies pdf documents through PdfPig: document information, page count, page sizes and extracted text.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.PdfPig
// Note: The samples read sample.pdf from the output directory. Add the file to the test project
// with a None Update item and CopyToOutputDirectory=PreserveNewest.
// Note: PagesToInclude trims only the info and text output. The .verified.pdf is always the whole
// document, because PdfPig has no in-place page splitter.
// Note: PagesToInclude and SkipPdfNormalization are defined in the VerifyTests namespace by
// several pdf plugins, so the fluent call fails to compile with CS0121 when two are referenced.
// The samples use the static form.
// Note: PdfPigSettings.PdfPigParsingOptions(settings, options) passes PdfPig ParsingOptions, for a
// password protected or malformed pdf. It is not in the readme.
// Note: PdfPig is fully managed, so there is no native dependency and nothing to install.
// Note: This extracts text and does not render, so there are no png targets. Verify.PDFium is the
// rendering alternative.
public class PdfPigTests
{
    // A pdf writes an info file with the document information, page count, page sizes and the
    // extracted text, plus a normalized .verified.pdf.
    // PagesToInclude trims the info file to the first pages, so a long document stays readable.
    // It is called in its static form because several pdf plugins define the same plugin
    // method in the VerifyTests namespace, and the fluent call is then ambiguous (CS0121).
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task Pdf()
    {
        var settings = new VerifySettings();
        PdfPigSettings.PagesToInclude(settings, 2);
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf", settings);
    }

    // A pdf produced in the test is verified as a stream, with pdf as the plugin.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task PdfStream()
    {
        return Verify(File.OpenRead("sample.pdf"), "pdf");
    }

    // The source pdf is included as a .verified.pdf. Where committing a binary is not wanted,
    // ExcludeTargets drops it and skips normalizing it, while the info and text still verify.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task ExcludePdf()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf")
            .ExcludeTargets("pdf");
    }

    // Snapshots the bytes as produced, skipping the pass that neutralizes the trailer /ID, the
    // /CreationDate and /ModDate, and the XMP dates. Only safe for a deterministic producer.
    // The static form again, for the same ambiguity reason as PagesToInclude.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task SkipNormalization()
    {
        var settings = new VerifySettings();
        PdfPigSettings.SkipPdfNormalization(settings);
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf", settings);
    }
}
